intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: The conversation runs out. Tavri lets it.

intro.speaker: TAVRI
intro.text: “Do you realize neither of us has said anything clever for a full minute?”

intro.speaker: TAVRI
intro.text: “Only if you brought an emergency trumpet.”

intro.speaker: TAVRI
intro.text: “I’m going for two minutes. That one didn’t count. It was commentary.”

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: Her tail twitches toward a joke, then settles.

options.labelText: “Go for three. I’ve got nowhere better to be.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: You make it to three. Somewhere in the second minute, her shoulder bumps against yours and stays.

options.labelText: “Don’t worry, I’ve got a joke ready if it gets slow.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: You tell it. She laughs at exactly the right moment, the way she does at court.
